name: connection
sql: SELECT DB_NAME() banco, @@SERVERNAME servidor, GETDATE() horario_servidor

name: locais
sql: SELECT NNR_FILIAL filial, NNR_CODIGO local, NNR_DESCRI descricao FROM dbo.NNR010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' ORDER BY NNR_FILIAL,NNR_CODIGO

name: tipos_movimento
sql: SELECT F5_FILIAL filial,F5_CODIGO tm,F5_TIPO tipo,F5_TEXTO descricao FROM dbo.SF5010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' ORDER BY F5_CODIGO

name: tes
sql: SELECT F4_FILIAL filial,F4_CODIGO tes,F4_TEXTO descricao,F4_ESTOQUE estoque,F4_CF cfop FROM dbo.SF4010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' ORDER BY F4_FILIAL,F4_CODIGO

name: SD3_cobertura
sql: SELECT D3_FILIAL filial,MIN(D3_EMISSAO) primeira,MAX(D3_EMISSAO) ultima,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas, SUM(CASE WHEN D3_EMISSAO>=? AND D3_EMISSAO<? THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END) linhas_periodo FROM dbo.SD3010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' GROUP BY D3_FILIAL

name: SD1_cobertura
sql: SELECT D1_FILIAL filial,MIN(D1_DTDIGIT) primeira,MAX(D1_DTDIGIT) ultima,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas, SUM(CASE WHEN D1_DTDIGIT>=? AND D1_DTDIGIT<? THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END) linhas_periodo FROM dbo.SD1010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' GROUP BY D1_FILIAL

name: SD2_cobertura
sql: SELECT D2_FILIAL filial,MIN(D2_EMISSAO) primeira,MAX(D2_EMISSAO) ultima,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas, SUM(CASE WHEN D2_EMISSAO>=? AND D2_EMISSAO<? THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END) linhas_periodo FROM dbo.SD2010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' GROUP BY D2_FILIAL

name: SC2_cobertura
sql: SELECT C2_FILIAL filial,MIN(C2_EMISSAO) primeira,MAX(C2_EMISSAO) ultima,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas, SUM(CASE WHEN C2_EMISSAO>=? AND C2_EMISSAO<? THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END) linhas_periodo FROM dbo.SC2010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' GROUP BY C2_FILIAL

name: sd3_tipos_locais
sql: SELECT D3_LOCAL local,D3_CF cf,D3_TM tm,D3_ESTORNO estorno,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas,COUNT(DISTINCT D3_COD) produtos,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(RTRIM(D3_OP),'')) ops,MIN(D3_EMISSAO) primeira,MAX(D3_EMISSAO) ultima FROM dbo.SD3010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL=? AND D3_EMISSAO>=? AND D3_EMISSAO<? GROUP BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM,D3_ESTORNO ORDER BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM,D3_ESTORNO

name: sd3_mensal
sql: SELECT LEFT(D3_EMISSAO,6) mes,D3_LOCAL local,D3_CF cf,D3_TM tm,D3_ESTORNO estorno,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas FROM dbo.SD3010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL=? AND D3_EMISSAO>=? AND D3_EMISSAO<? GROUP BY LEFT(D3_EMISSAO,6),D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM,D3_ESTORNO ORDER BY mes,local,cf,tm

name: sd3_amostras
sql: WITH sample AS (SELECT D3_LOCAL local,D3_CF cf,D3_TM tm,D3_ESTORNO estorno,D3_EMISSAO data,D3_COD produto,D3_QUANT quantidade,D3_UM unidade,D3_DOC documento,D3_OP op,D3_NUMSEQ sequencia,R_E_C_N_O_ recno,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY D3_LOCAL,D3_CF,D3_TM,D3_ESTORNO ORDER BY D3_EMISSAO DESC,R_E_C_N_O_ DESC) rn FROM dbo.SD3010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL=? AND D3_EMISSAO>=? AND D3_EMISSAO<?) SELECT * FROM sample WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY local,cf,tm,estorno,rn

name: SD1_tipos_locais
sql: SELECT D1_LOCAL local,D1_TIPO tipo,D1_CF cfop,D1_TES tes,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas,COUNT(DISTINCT D1_COD) produtos,MIN(D1_DTDIGIT) primeira,MAX(D1_DTDIGIT) ultima FROM dbo.SD1010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D1_FILIAL=? AND D1_DTDIGIT>=? AND D1_DTDIGIT<? GROUP BY D1_LOCAL,D1_TIPO,D1_CF,D1_TES ORDER BY local,tipo,cfop,tes

name: SD2_tipos_locais
sql: SELECT D2_LOCAL local,D2_TIPO tipo,D2_CF cfop,D2_TES tes,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas,COUNT(DISTINCT D2_COD) produtos,MIN(D2_EMISSAO) primeira,MAX(D2_EMISSAO) ultima FROM dbo.SD2010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D2_FILIAL=? AND D2_EMISSAO>=? AND D2_EMISSAO<? GROUP BY D2_LOCAL,D2_TIPO,D2_CF,D2_TES ORDER BY local,tipo,cfop,tes

name: ops_criadas
sql: SELECT C2_LOCAL local,COUNT_BIG(*) ops,SUM(CASE WHEN C2_DATRF<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) encerradas,SUM(CASE WHEN C2_QUJE>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) com_producao,MIN(C2_EMISSAO) primeira,MAX(C2_EMISSAO) ultima FROM dbo.SC2010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND C2_FILIAL=? AND C2_EMISSAO>=? AND C2_EMISSAO<? GROUP BY C2_LOCAL ORDER BY C2_LOCAL

name: roteamento_producao
sql: SELECT c.C2_LOCAL local_op,d.D3_LOCAL local_entrada,d.D3_ESTORNO estorno,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas,COUNT(DISTINCT d.D3_OP) ops FROM dbo.SD3010 d JOIN dbo.SC2010 c ON c.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND c.C2_FILIAL=d.D3_FILIAL AND RTRIM(c.C2_NUM)+RTRIM(c.C2_ITEM)+RTRIM(c.C2_SEQUEN)=RTRIM(d.D3_OP) WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D3_FILIAL=? AND d.D3_EMISSAO>=? AND d.D3_EMISSAO<? AND d.D3_CF='PR0' GROUP BY c.C2_LOCAL,d.D3_LOCAL,d.D3_ESTORNO ORDER BY local_op,local_entrada,estorno

name: transferencias_linhas
sql: SELECT D3_FILIAL filial,D3_LOCAL local,D3_CF cf,D3_TM tm,D3_ESTORNO estorno,D3_EMISSAO data,D3_COD produto,D3_QUANT quantidade,D3_UM unidade,D3_DOC documento,D3_NUMSEQ sequencia,R_E_C_N_O_ recno FROM dbo.SD3010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL=? AND D3_EMISSAO>=? AND D3_EMISSAO<? AND D3_CF IN ('RE4','DE4') ORDER BY D3_EMISSAO,D3_DOC,D3_COD,R_E_C_N_O_

name: empenhos_ops_periodo
sql: SELECT c.C2_LOCAL local_op,d.D4_LOCAL local_empenho,COUNT_BIG(*) linhas,COUNT(DISTINCT d.D4_OP) ops FROM dbo.SD4010 d JOIN dbo.SC2010 c ON c.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND c.C2_FILIAL=d.D4_FILIAL AND RTRIM(c.C2_NUM)+RTRIM(c.C2_ITEM)+RTRIM(c.C2_SEQUEN)=RTRIM(d.D4_OP) WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND c.C2_FILIAL=? AND c.C2_EMISSAO>=? AND c.C2_EMISSAO<? GROUP BY c.C2_LOCAL,d.D4_LOCAL ORDER BY local_op,local_empenho
